e1ebm10u7wok5.speaker: narr

e1ebm10u7wok5.heard: January eighteen sixty. The forest of Angkor Thom.
e1ebm10u7wok5.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e25nttget8sk.speaker: narr
e25nttget8sk.text: The roots of huge trees were wrapped around the stone towers. The faces on the towers smiled quietly between the leaves.
e25nttget8sk.heard: The roots of huge trees were wrapped around the stone towers. The faces on the towers smiled quietly between the leaves.
e25nttget8sk.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

exa1hzv1yagq.speaker: narr
exa1hzv1yagq.text: In those days, this area was ruled by the neighbouring kingdom of Siam. Even so, the people of the villages by the forest still lived here, just as they always had.
exa1hzv1yagq.heard: In those days, this area was ruled by the neighbouring kingdom of Siam. Even so, the people of the villages by the forest still lived here, just as they always had.

erltcl71qmbd.speaker: narr
erltcl71qmbd.text: Somewhere, a monkey was chattering and dogs were barking.
erltcl71qmbd.heard: Somewhere, a monkey was chattering and dogs were barking.
erltcl71qmbd.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

elgku9pvmglc.speaker: nimol
elgku9pvmglc.text: Shhh! …Who are you? You're not from the village, are you?
elgku9pvmglc.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1it7sgp1rtoo.speaker: nimol
e1it7sgp1rtoo.text: I'm Nimol. I'm ten. I bring the water buffalo to graze in this forest.
e1it7sgp1rtoo.heard: I'm ten. I bring the water buffalo to graze in this forest.
e1it7sgp1rtoo.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

eybnsgxmtw77.speaker: nimol
eybnsgxmtw77.text: Oh, you came again? Shhh, keep quiet.
eybnsgxmtw77.heard: Oh, you came again? Shhh, keep quiet.
eybnsgxmtw77.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1asgbx21f14e.speaker: nimol
e1asgbx21f14e.text: I'm Nimol. I look after the water buffalo in this forest.
e1asgbx21f14e.heard: I look after the water buffalo in this forest.
e1asgbx21f14e.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1jha1xf1mm1r.speaker: nimol
e1jha1xf1mm1r.text: Look. There's a strange man over there. His face is all beard. And there's a monkey sitting on his shoulder!
e1jha1xf1mm1r.heard: Look. There's a strange man over there. His face is all beard. And there's a monkey sitting on his shoulder!
e1jha1xf1mm1r.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1sz8bfh13oml.speaker: mouhot
e1sz8bfh13oml.text: Ah, hello there. …Did I startle you?
e1sz8bfh13oml.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1t4ht4718cpc.speaker: mouhot
e1t4ht4718cpc.text: I am Henri Mouhot. I came from France. I collect insects and shells in the forest and study them.
e1t4ht4718cpc.heard: I am Henri Mouhot. I came from France. I collect insects and shells in the forest and study them.
e1t4ht4718cpc.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e3yj78z108ly.speaker: mouhot
e3yj78z108ly.text: Ah, we meet again. …Did I startle you?
e3yj78z108ly.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1k32bizzymqt.speaker: mouhot
e1k32bizzymqt.text: Ah, hello there. …Oh? You look as if you know me.
e1k32bizzymqt.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1ga4n3f1cmmm.speaker: mouhot
e1ga4n3f1cmmm.text: I am Henri Mouhot. I collect insects and shells in the forest and study them.
e1ga4n3f1cmmm.heard: I am Henri Mouhot. I collect insects and shells in the forest and study them.
e1ga4n3f1cmmm.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1anaal51r5mu.speaker: mouhot
e1anaal51r5mu.text: This monkey and these dogs are my travelling companions. A priest from Battambang guided me here, but I've got completely lost inside this temple.
e1anaal51r5mu.heard: This monkey and these dogs are my travelling companions. A priest from Battambang guided me here, but I've got completely lost inside this temple.
e1anaal51r5mu.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

eb0wa1yji9f.speaker: nimol
eb0wa1yji9f.text: Ha ha! Everyone gets lost in this temple!
eb0wa1yji9f.heard: Ha ha! Everyone gets lost in this temple!
eb0wa1yji9f.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e9xufok16mlu.speaker: nimol
e9xufok16mlu.text: In the village, we call this place “Prea sat Ling poun.” It means “the temple of hide-and-seek.”
e9xufok16mlu.heard: In the village, we call this place “Prea sat Ling poun.” It means “the temple of hide-and-seek.”
e9xufok16mlu.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

euk6p2y1h1ov.speaker: nimol
euk6p2y1h1ov.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1qe2op6nprvr.speaker: nimol
e1qe2op6nprvr.text: Because the paths go round and round, and there are lots of places to hide.
e1qe2op6nprvr.heard: Because the paths go round and round, and there are lots of places to hide.
e1qe2op6nprvr.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1e1l3rj1v10k.speaker: mouhot
e1e1l3rj1v10k.text: The temple of hide-and-seek…! What a fine name. I must write that down.
e1e1l3rj1v10k.heard: The temple of hide-and-seek…! What a fine name. I must write that down.
e1e1l3rj1v10k.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

ey426wvce03m.speaker: narr
ey426wvce03m.text: Mouhot opened the sketchbook he carried under his arm and jotted it down quickly.
ey426wvce03m.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e10owa6t1y2cs.speaker: nekmax
e10owa6t1y2cs.text: That's a name Mouhot really wrote down. He also wrote that the galleries cross each other, so it's hard to find your way.
e10owa6t1y2cs.heard: That's a name Mouhot really wrote down. He also wrote that the galleries cross each other, so it's hard to find your way.
e10owa6t1y2cs.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e9f6s5k1vkol.speaker: nimol
e9f6s5k1vkol.text: Hey, let's play! I'll hide, and you two come and find me!
e9f6s5k1vkol.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e16nqw56116kf.speaker: narr
e16nqw56116kf.text: Nimol slipped away behind a stone pillar.
e16nqw56116kf.scene: お祝いの、晴れやかな場面。明るく

ecniq3ll2n6l.speaker: narr
ecniq3ll2n6l.text: You walked down the dark gallery. The dancers carved on the walls seemed to look back at you. …She wasn't there.
ecniq3ll2n6l.heard: You walked down the dark gallery. The dancers carved on the walls seemed to look back at you. …She wasn't
ecniq3ll2n6l.scene: お祝いの、晴れやかな場面。明るく

ennr3n31wevz.speaker: narr
ennr3n31wevz.text: When you turned around, Nimol was giggling behind a pillar you had just walked past.
ennr3n31wevz.heard: When you turned around, Nimol was giggling behind a pillar you had just walked past.
ennr3n31wevz.scene: お祝いの、晴れやかな場面。明るく

e1tn124rxpjf3.speaker: narr
e1tn124rxpjf3.text: You looked up. A huge stone face was gazing down at you. From a gap below the face, Nimol's hand was waving at you.
e1tn124rxpjf3.heard: A huge stone face was gazing down at you. From a gap below the face, Nimol's hand was waving at you.
e1tn124rxpjf3.scene: お祝いの、晴れやかな場面。明るく

e1hi3g68zvl5y.speaker: nimol
e1hi3g68zvl5y.text: You two kept going round and round the same spot the whole time.
e1hi3g68zvl5y.scene: お祝いの、晴れやかな場面。明るく

e1uvgk1sxqsuc.speaker: narr
e1uvgk1sxqsuc.text: The monkey on Mouhot's shoulder gave a squeak, as if it were laughing.
e1uvgk1sxqsuc.scene: お祝いの、晴れやかな場面。明るく

e1scnta413h81.speaker: mouhot
e1scnta413h81.text: I give up. …But thanks to that, I was able to count every tower. Thirty-seven.
e1scnta413h81.heard: But thanks to that, I was able to count every tower. Thirty-seven.
e1scnta413h81.scene: お祝いの、晴れやかな場面。明るく

ezj2mypr4w8j.speaker: nimol
ezj2mypr4w8j.text: You counted them? You don't need to count. Everyone in the village knows this place.
ezj2mypr4w8j.heard: You don't need to count. Everyone in the village knows this place.
ezj2mypr4w8j.scene: お祝いの、晴れやかな場面。明るく

e2nxvfknni6q.speaker: nimol
e2nxvfknni6q.text: My grandma comes here to offer flowers on the day of the full moon, too.
e2nxvfknni6q.scene: お祝いの、晴れやかな場面。明るく

e3m7uuz1h1jv.speaker: nekmax
e3m7uuz1h1jv.text: Mouhot counted thirty-seven towers. Counted the way we do today, the Bayon is said to have 49 or 54 towers.
e3m7uuz1h1jv.heard: Mouhot counted thirty-seven towers. Counted the way we do today, the Bayon is said to have 49 or 54 towers.
e3m7uuz1h1jv.scene: お祝いの、晴れやかな場面。明るく

ewhzpxthhw1g.speaker: mouhot
ewhzpxthhw1g.text: Nimol. Will you tell me one thing? The great temple beyond the forest that I saw the other day… who built it, I wonder?
ewhzpxthhw1g.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

eip35ahkwl15.speaker: narr
eip35ahkwl15.text: Just then, villagers carrying firewood on their backs came by. Nimol asked the grown-ups for him.
eip35ahkwl15.heard: Just then, villagers carrying firewood on their backs came by. Nimol asked the grown-ups for him.
eip35ahkwl15.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1i3xzijqmxcz.speaker: 村のおじいさん
e1i3xzijqmxcz.text: That was made by the king of the heavens, Pra-Eun.
e1i3xzijqmxcz.heard: That was made by the king of the heavens, Pra-Eun.
e1i3xzijqmxcz.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

ebq852p1ob39.speaker: 村のおばさん
ebq852p1ob39.text: Oh? I heard giants made it.
ebq852p1ob39.heard: Oh? I heard giants made it.
ebq852p1ob39.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

ey0v1x61mkqi.speaker: 村の若者
ey0v1x61mkqi.text: My grandpa said the Sick King built it.
ey0v1x61mkqi.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

evoy59v19498.speaker: 村のおばあさん
evoy59v19498.text: Ho ho. That one? It made itself.
evoy59v19498.heard: Ho ho. That one? It made itself.
evoy59v19498.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

epn8o6c28v1a.speaker: narr
epn8o6c28v1a.text: Mouhot carefully wrote down the four answers, one by one.
epn8o6c28v1a.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1o6dg2tidbcj.speaker: mouhot
e1o6dg2tidbcj.text: The work of giants, eh? …As a figure of speech, that is exactly right.
e1o6dg2tidbcj.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1nydnifzeykn.speaker: nekmax
e1nydnifzeykn.text: These four answers are really written in Mouhot's book. The villagers each knew that temple through their own legends.
e1nydnifzeykn.heard: These four answers are really written in Mouhot's book. The villagers each knew that temple through their own legends.
e1nydnifzeykn.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1x99ufvc09qa.speaker: mouhot
e1x99ufvc09qa.text: Traveller. Which answer do you like best?
e1x99ufvc09qa.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1teh0zs1a7sz.speaker: mouhot
e1teh0zs1a7sz.text: Yes — that's how magnificent the temple is. …But it was human hands that carved those stones.
e1teh0zs1a7sz.heard: Yes — that's how magnificent the temple is. …But it was human hands that carved
e1teh0zs1a7sz.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

efefcn41t72g.speaker: mouhot
efefcn41t72g.text: I vote for that one too. As a figure of speech, that is.
efefcn41t72g.heard: I vote for that one too. As a figure of speech,
efefcn41t72g.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1j04ykl1hv4s.speaker: mouhot
e1j04ykl1hv4s.text: …Yes. There must have been countless people who carried and carved the stones. Even if their names were not left behind.
e1j04ykl1hv4s.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e16q92901s2ix.speaker: nekmax
e16q92901s2ix.text: (whispering) That means Keo and the others. All the stone carvers whose names were never recorded.
e16q92901s2ix.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e8fzzjnq2vpp.speaker: mouhot
e8fzzjnq2vpp.text: I'm no expert at all in buildings or ancient things.
e8fzzjnq2vpp.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1otsnkjsrlch.speaker: mouhot
e1otsnkjsrlch.text: But I want to write down what I see here as truly as I can, and let people in faraway countries know.
e1otsnkjsrlch.heard: But I want to write down what I see here as truly as I can, and let people in faraway countries know.
e1otsnkjsrlch.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

en3q21arzo43.speaker: nimol
en3q21arzo43.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1rgcs351hxfp.speaker: mouhot
e1rgcs351hxfp.text: …Well. I'm sure many people will want to see this temple.
e1rgcs351hxfp.heard: Well. I'm sure many people will want to see this temple.
e1rgcs351hxfp.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1qg0uk964nnu.speaker: nimol
e1qg0uk964nnu.text: Hmm. Then when they come, I'll show them around. Nobody knows the temple of hide-and-seek better than me.
e1qg0uk964nnu.heard: Then when they come, I'll show them around. Nobody knows the temple of hide-and-seek better than me.
e1qg0uk964nnu.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

ehpswrcdzox5.speaker: narr
ehpswrcdzox5.text: Mouhot burst out laughing. The monkey on his shoulder squeaked too, as if clapping its hands.
ehpswrcdzox5.heard: Mouhot burst out laughing. The monkey on his shoulder squeaked too, as if clapping its hands.
ehpswrcdzox5.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

eb0k7x61fuar.speaker: nekmax
eb0k7x61fuar.text: …We're back. This is the Bayon today.
eb0k7x61fuar.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

egk4sbb1hlk1.speaker: nekmax
egk4sbb1hlk1.text: Mouhot stayed at Angkor for about three weeks and wrote down what he saw in his diary.
egk4sbb1hlk1.heard: Mouhot stayed at Angkor for about three weeks and wrote down what he saw in his diary.
egk4sbb1hlk1.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

emz41t2ghiak.speaker: nekmax
emz41t2ghiak.text: He wrote that Angkor Wat was “grander than anything left to us by Greece or Rome.”
emz41t2ghiak.heard: He wrote that Angkor Wat was “grander than anything left to us by Greece or Rome.”
emz41t2ghiak.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e11urbvr1krdb.speaker: nekmax
e11urbvr1krdb.text: The next year, Mouhot fell ill in Laos and died. His family gathered his letters and diaries and made them into a book.
e11urbvr1krdb.heard: The next year, Mouhot fell ill in Laos and died. His family gathered his letters and diaries and made them
e11urbvr1krdb.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

ergqvgg1x772.speaker: nekmax
ergqvgg1x772.text: That book became famous, and Mouhot came to be called “the man who discovered Angkor.”
ergqvgg1x772.heard: That book became famous, and Mouhot came to be called “the man who discovered Angkor.”
ergqvgg1x772.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

eho0mzw1b9p8.speaker: nekmax
eho0mzw1b9p8.text: But if you read the English translation of Mouhot's book, in the chapters about Angkor he himself never says he “discovered” it. The ones who called him that were the people around him, and the people of later times.
eho0mzw1b9p8.heard: But if you read the English translation of Mouhot's book, in the chapters about Angkor he himself never says he “discovered” it. The ones who called him that were the people around him, and the people of later
eho0mzw1b9p8.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

ehbshhj1kb26.speaker: nekmax
ehbshhj1kb26.text: Angkor was never discovered. It was here all along — the villagers knew it, and came here to pray.
ehbshhj1kb26.heard: Angkor was never discovered. It was here all along — the villagers knew it, and came here to pray.
ehbshhj1kb26.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1l1fa51olsz.speaker: nekmax
e1l1fa51olsz.text: Lots of travellers came here before Mouhot, too.
e1l1fa51olsz.heard: Lots of travellers came here before Mouhot, too.
e1l1fa51olsz.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1pipehw150su.speaker: nekmax
e1pipehw150su.text: In 1296, Zhou Daguan from Yuan China. In 1586, a Portuguese friar. In the early 1600s, people from Japan. In 1850, Father Bouillevaux, a French priest.
e1pipehw150su.heard: In 1296, Zhou Daguan from Yuan China. In 1586, a Portuguese friar. In the early 1600s, people from Japan. In 1850, Father Bouillevaux, a French priest.
e1pipehw150su.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1dblsjxrstlx.speaker: nekmax
e1dblsjxrstlx.text: (whispering) We met Zhou Daguan too, didn't we? He was another traveller who wrote down what he saw.
e1dblsjxrstlx.heard: We met Zhou Daguan too, didn't we? He was another traveller who wrote down what he saw.
e1dblsjxrstlx.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

ec6pwxkgkay3.speaker: nekmax
ec6pwxkgkay3.text: (whispering) Morimoto Ukondayu also wrote about his journey in ink on a pillar, didn't he?
ec6pwxkgkay3.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1cvbrz31t45b.speaker: nekmax
e1cvbrz31t45b.text: And today — you are the newest traveller in that long line.
e1cvbrz31t45b.heard: And today — you are the newest traveller in that long line.
e1cvbrz31t45b.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

elwkwx22ot1a.speaker: nekmax
elwkwx22ot1a.text: At the ruins today, please don't climb on the stones or play hide-and-seek. The precious stones could crumble.
elwkwx22ot1a.heard: At the ruins today, please don't climb on the stones or play hide-and-seek. The precious stones could crumble.
elwkwx22ot1a.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1kp7nk8e9vtc.speaker: nekmax
e1kp7nk8e9vtc.text: (whispering) …I bet Nimol would still be the best guide to this temple, even now.
e1kp7nk8e9vtc.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1w4mwuf1r35f.speaker: vichet2
e1w4mwuf1r35f.text: Whenever I see those towers, I remember the long days of waiting for the ferry.
e1w4mwuf1r35f.heard: Whenever I see those towers, I remember the long days of waiting for the ferry.
e1w4mwuf1r35f.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

ewuxg9f1xada.speaker: vichet2
ewuxg9f1xada.text: Now I ride under them every day, off to connect villages to the internet.
ewuxg9f1xada.heard: Now I ride under them every day, off to connect villages to the internet.
ewuxg9f1xada.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e6m0raumzu04.speaker: mony2
e6m0raumzu04.text: Those legs don’t budge, even when the river runs strong in the rainy season.
e6m0raumzu04.heard: Those legs don't budge, even when the river runs strong in the rainy season.
e6m0raumzu04.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

el8wchgitfgs.speaker: mony2
el8wchgitfgs.text: We took the bamboo bridge apart every year, but this bridge stays here, always.
el8wchgitfgs.heard: We took the bamboo bridge apart every year, but this bridge stays here, always.
el8wchgitfgs.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1bqd3f94fmvx.speaker: keo
e1bqd3f94fmvx.text: Did you meet them? Which one do you think I carved?
e1bqd3f94fmvx.heard: Which one do you think I carved?
e1bqd3f94fmvx.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

efknkbo141se.speaker: keo
efknkbo141se.text: My name wasn’t kept — but look, she’s still right here.
efknkbo141se.heard: My name wasn’t kept — but look, she’s still right here.
efknkbo141se.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e19tajfl8v1ky.speaker: chanthy
e19tajfl8v1ky.text: Found them? The one holding the scales might be my mum.
e19tajfl8v1ky.heard: Found them? The one holding the scales might be my mom.
e19tajfl8v1ky.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1n5s7eh12esn.speaker: chanthy
e1n5s7eh12esn.text: Even in the stone, she weighs fish every day.
e1n5s7eh12esn.heard: Even in the stone, she weighs fish every day.
e1n5s7eh12esn.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

er71su6ibrr1.speaker: sreymom
er71su6ibrr1.text: A tree this big, in the temple where I danced…!
er71su6ibrr1.heard: A tree this big, in the temple where I danced!
er71su6ibrr1.scene: おだやかな場面。落ち着いた声で

e1clxy2911k9y.speaker: sreymom
e1clxy2911k9y.text: So this is what eight hundred years looks like. The tree looks like it’s hugging the temple.
